home.titleDefault: Raja Bali | One of the Best Restaurants in Bali
home.description: Raja Bali is one of the best restaurants in Bali, a Tripadvisor Travelers' Choice Award winner for five consecutive years, offering authentic Balinese cuisine in Nusa Dua, cultural dance performances, and hands-on cooking and cocktail classes.

about.title: About Us
about.description: The story behind Raja Bali, a restaurant rooted in Balinese tradition, authentic recipes, fresh local ingredients, and warm island hospitality in Nusa Dua.

outlets.title: Our Locations
outlets.description: Discover Raja Bali's two destinations in Nusa Dua, Raja Bali Nusa Dua (Main Restaurant) and Raja Bali Nusa Dua (Dine-in Restaurant), with maps, hours, and booking links for each.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.description: Get in touch with Raja Bali Nusa Dua (Main Restaurant) or Raja Bali Nusa Dua (Dine-in Restaurant) for reservations, enquiries, and directions to both locations in Nusa Dua.

gallery.title: Gallery
gallery.description: A glimpse into the flavors, celebrations, and warm hospitality that define every Raja Bali experience: dining, cooking and bar classes, dance, and private events.

menuFood.title: Food Menu
menuFood.description: Explore Raja Bali's food menu, featuring appetizers, soups, vegetarian dishes, rice & noodles, main courses, betutu, and Balinese set menus, all made with authentic recipes.

menuBeverage.title: Beverage Menu
menuBeverage.description: Raja Bali's beverage menu features signature cocktails, wine, and refreshments crafted with tropical, island-inspired flavors.

menuBalineseBuffet.title: Balinese Buffet Menu
menuBalineseBuffet.description: Raja Bali's group dinner buffet menu featuring authentic Balinese dishes, starting from IDR 300K per person, ideal for group celebrations.

menuWesternAsianBuffet.title: Western & Asian Buffet Menu
menuWesternAsianBuffet.description: Raja Bali's group dinner buffet menu featuring Western & Asian favorites, starting from IDR 350K per person, ideal for groups with different preferences.

cookingClass.title: Balinese Cooking Class in Bali
cookingClass.description: Hands-on Balinese cooking class in Nusa Dua. Learn authentic recipes, tour our spice garden, and enjoy what you cook. From IDR 550K/person.

barClass.title: Balinese Cocktail Class
barClass.description: Join Raja Bali's hands-on Balinese cocktail class in Nusa Dua, with three daily sessions to choose from. Visit on a Thursday to also enjoy our complimentary Balinese dance performance from 7 PM.

dance.title: Balinese Dance Performance
dance.description: The only Balinese Dance performance in Nusa Dua. Watch it complimentary every Thursday evening at Raja Bali Nusa Dua (Main Restaurant), free for dining guests.

privateEvents.title: Private Events
privateEvents.description: Celebrate life's special moments at Raja Bali in Bali's Nusa Dua area, with private event spaces and personalized event planning for weddings, corporate dinners, and celebrations.

venueRental.title: Garden & Meeting Room Rental in Nusa Dua
venueRental.description: Rent Raja Bali's garden or private meeting room in Nusa Dua by the hour, for your own yoga class, photoshoot, fitness class, stand-up comedy night, corporate meeting, training, or workshop.

groupReservation.title: Corporate & Group Dining in Bali
groupReservation.description: Host corporate dinners, company gatherings, and group celebrations at Raja Bali in Bali's Nusa Dua area. Reserve your group dining experience today.

reservationMain.title: Authentic Balinese Restaurant in Nusa Dua | Raja Bali Nusa Dua (Main Restaurant)
reservationMain.description: Reserve a table at Raja Bali Nusa Dua (Main Restaurant). Authentic Balinese dining, cooking classes, and cultural performances await.

reservationNusadua.title: Balinese Restaurant in Nusa Dua | Raja Bali Nusa Dua (Dine-in Restaurant)
reservationNusadua.description: Reserve a table at Raja Bali Nusa Dua (Dine-in Restaurant) for authentic Balinese cuisine in an elegant setting, perfect for romantic dinners and memorable evenings in Nusa Dua.

share.title: Share Raja Bali
share.description: Share your Raja Bali experience with friends and family.
